note: Machine-readable index of the third-party CODE / RUNTIME components that ship INSIDE the distribution and whose verbatim license text travels under THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/runtime/. The deploy wizard reads this to group and display licenses. Dependency closures installed at deploy time (NOT bundled) are inventoried separately: the Python/PyPI closure in python_packages.json, and the backend Node production closure in node_packages.json (the latter is GENERATED after `npm ci` by tools/build/gen_node_licenses.py from the installed node_modules metadata).
